verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Hummingbird has a Case API for creating or updating cases, and APIs for listing and fetching cases for data syncing. Nothing documents stable external identifiers or a way to reconcile customer (CRM) and case records by those IDs. General create, update and sync APIs are adjacent building blocks, not the named reconciliation capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reconcile customer and case records with stable external identifiers
